## Ambiq Expands Zephyr Support to New Apollo330 Plus and Apollo510 Lite SoCs


Ambiq Expands Zephyr Support to New Apollo330 Plus and Apollo510 Lite SoCs 2


**AUSTIN, TX, September 8, 2026 — Ambiq Micro, Inc. (“Ambiq®”),** a technology leader in ultra-low-power semiconductor solutions for edge AI, today announced expanded support for the open-source **Zephyr Project®** Real-Time Operating System (RTOS) on its latest **Apollo330 Plus** and **Apollo510 Lite Series SoCs** . The expansion further strengthens Ambiq’s software ecosystem and makes it easier for embedded developers to bring existing workflows to Ambiq’s energy-efficient edge AI platforms.


The expanded Zephyr support is part of Ambiq’s continued investment in a broader, more accessible software ecosystem for edge AI development. It gives embedded developers greater flexibility to use existing software and familiar development workflows with the Apollo330 Plus and Apollo510 Lite Series, helping reduce migration effort while opening a path to the energy efficiency of Ambiq’s latest SoCs.


With Zephyr support, developers can combine a familiar open-source development environment with the energy efficiency enabled by Ambiq’s proprietary SPOT® platform (Subthreshold Power Optimized Technology platform). Alongside Ambiq’s HELIA™ AI ecosystem, this expanding software foundation gives developers greater flexibility to build, optimize, and deploy increasingly sophisticated edge AI workloads on Ambiq hardware.


“As edge AI applications grow more capable and complex, developers need more than energy-efficient compute; they need a software environment that helps them move quickly from development to deployment,” said **Scott Hanson** , **CTO** of **Ambiq** . “Expanding Zephyr support across our latest Apollo SoCs reflects our continued commitment to the software foundation of our SPOT platform. Together with our HELIA AI ecosystem, we’re giving developers greater flexibility to create and refine more sophisticated edge AI applications on Ambiq.”


Zephyr support for the Apollo330 Plus and Apollo510 Lite Series builds on Ambiq’s existing support for the Apollo3 Family, Apollo4 Plus, Apollo4 Blue Plus, and Apollo510 SoCs, extending the open-source development environment across a growing range of Ambiq devices.


Developers can access[Ambiq’s Zephyr code on GitHub](https://github.com/AmbiqMicro/ambiqzephyr/blob/ambiq-stable/README.rst) to get started today.


For more information on the Apollo330 Plus and Apollo510 Lite Series, please visit the links below:


[Apollo330 Plus Series Product Page](https://ambiq.com/product/apollo330-plus-series/)


**[Apollo510 Lite Series Product Page](https://ambiq.com/product/apollo510-lite-series/)**


**About Ambiq**
Ambiq’s mission is to enable intelligence (artificial intelligence (AI) and beyond) everywhere by delivering the lowest power semiconductor solutions. Built on its patented Subthreshold Power Optimized Technology (SPOT®) and the HELIA™ AI platform, Ambiq empowers manufacturers to bring more capable AI to the edge, where power, memory, and energy efficiency are most critical. Ambiq enables more intelligent, always-on edge devices across healthcare, wearables, industrial automation, smart environments, and other emerging AI applications. With more than 300 million devices shipped worldwide, Ambiq continues to shape the future of always-on Edge AI. Headquartered in Austin, Texas, Ambiq serves customers globally. For more information, visit[www.ambiq.com](https://www.ambiq.com/) .
